guideTitle: AI-Assisted Template Guide - How to fill the metadata spreadsheet
guideAlert: You can use an AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to pre-fill the batch template. Copy the prompt below, paste it into your AI tool, and use the result to fill the Excel spreadsheet before exporting it as UTF-16 Unicode Text (.txt).
prompt:
I need to fill a batch upload spreadsheet for [N] contents by [Author First Name] [Author Last Name], created in [YEAR].
All contents belong to the category [CATEGORY]. The Rights Representative is [CMO acronym or author's name].

Please create one tab-separated row per content using these column headers in order:
Author first name | Author nick name | Author surname | Content title | Year
| Description Eng | Description Fr | Description Other | Other Language
| Category1 | Category2 | Category3 | Categories | Country
| Rights Representation Acronym | Rights Holder | Place | Credits
| Path content (HD) | Path trailer (TR) | Path Image | Keywords | Streaming (1/0) | License Type

Title, Surname, Category, Year (YYYY or YYYY-YYYY) are mandatory.

Rights Representation Acronym: enter the CMO acronym (e.g. ADAGP, DACS, VG Bild-Kunst, SIAE, VEGAP, SABAM, BONO, Bildupphovsrätt).
If the author is not a member of any CMO, enter the author's own full name as the Rights Holder.

Streaming: 1 = streams in the web player (default, leave blank if unsure), 0 = standalone player only.

License Type — enter a label or its numeric id:
  FREE (-1), COPYRIGHT (-2), COPYLEFT (-3)
  CC_BY (-4), CC_BY_SA (-5), CC_BY_ND (-6), CC_BY_NC (-7), CC_BY_NC_SA (-8), CC_BY_NC_ND (-9)
  OTHER (-10), NO_ACCESS (-11), CC0 (-12)

The contents (file names) are:
- [filename_1.mp4]
- [filename_2.mp4]

The result must be saved as UTF-16 Unicode Text (.txt) format.
rightsRepExamples: Examples: ADAGP - France | DACS - UK | VG Bild-Kunst - Germany | SIAE - Italy | VEGAP - Spain | SABAM - Belgium | BONO - Norway | Bildupphovsrätt - Sweden
rightsRepWarning: If the Author is NOT a member of any CMO, enter the author's own full name as the Rights Holder (e.g. Christian Zimmermann).
streaming1: 1 (or leave blank) - content streams via the web player (default for all plugin uploads)
streaming0: 0 - URL is hidden from the web player; content plays only in the protected standalone player
fileNaming1: Use hyphens - or underscores _ instead of spaces.
fileNaming2: The filename in the spreadsheet must match the file you upload (accents are supported).
accountRestricted: Account Restricted - Batch Upload is available for logged-in editors and administrators only.

dropZone2Label: Drop content files here, or click to browse
